Standardize pathway enrichment results

Source: R/enrichment_plots.R
standardize_enrichment.Rd

Reads enrichment results from fgsea, clusterProfiler (GSEA or over-representation) or the GSEA desktop application into one table with standard column names, for plot_enrichment_dots and plot_enrichment_bars.

Usage

standardize_enrichment(
  data,
  method = c("auto", "fgsea", "clusterProfiler", "gsea"),
  comparison.col = NULL,
  clean.terms = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame of results, a clusterProfiler `gseaResult` / `enrichResult` object, or a named list of either (names = comparisons)

method

The tool: "auto" (default) detects it from the columns; or "fgsea", "clusterProfiler" (GSEA or over-representation, told apart by their columns) or "gsea" (GSEA desktop report, e.g. read with read.delim(..., check.names = FALSE); combine its two gsea_report_for_* files with rbind() first)

comparison.col

For a single table holding several comparisons, the column naming the comparison of each row. Default is NULL

clean.terms

Whether to make MSigDB-style names readable (drop the collection prefix such as "HALLMARK_" or "GOBP_", underscores to spaces, sentence case), default is TRUE. Other names only get a capital first letter when their first word is all lower case (GO descriptions). The original names are kept in `term_id`

Value

A data frame with columns `term`, `term_id`, `comparison` (when several), `nes`, `pvalue`, `padj`, `size`, `gene_ratio`, `count`, `leading_edge` and `type` ("gsea" or "ora"); columns a tool does not report are NA

Details

Columns read:

tooltermnespadjsizeleading_edge
fgseapathwayNESpadjsizeleadingEdge
clusterProfiler GSEADescriptionNESp.adjustsetSizecore_enrichment
clusterProfiler ORADescriptionnonep.adjustBgRatio (M of M/N)geneID
GSEA desktopNAMENESFDR q-valSIZEnone

For over-representation results, `gene_ratio` is k / n from `GeneRatio` ("k/n") and `count` is `Count`. For the GSEA desktop application, `padj` is its FDR q-value.

See also

plot_enrichment_dots, plot_enrichment_bars

Examples

fg <- data.frame(
    pathway = c("HALLMARK_HYPOXIA", "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS"),
    pval = c(1e-4, 0.2), padj = c(1e-3, 0.3), NES = c(2.1, -0.8), size = c(150, 190)
)
standardize_enrichment(fg)
#>          term              term_id  nes pvalue  padj size gene_ratio count
#> 1     Hypoxia     HALLMARK_HYPOXIA  2.1  1e-04 0.001  150         NA    NA
#> 2 E2F targets HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS -0.8  2e-01 0.300  190         NA    NA
#>   leading_edge type
#> 1         <NA> gsea
#> 2         <NA> gsea
standardize_enrichment(list("KO vs WT" = fg, "Het vs WT" = fg))
#>          term              term_id comparison  nes pvalue  padj size gene_ratio
#> 1     Hypoxia     HALLMARK_HYPOXIA   KO vs WT  2.1  1e-04 0.001  150         NA
#> 2 E2F targets HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS   KO vs WT -0.8  2e-01 0.300  190         NA
#> 3     Hypoxia     HALLMARK_HYPOXIA  Het vs WT  2.1  1e-04 0.001  150         NA
#> 4 E2F targets HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS  Het vs WT -0.8  2e-01 0.300  190         NA
#>   count leading_edge type
#> 1    NA         <NA> gsea
#> 2    NA         <NA> gsea
#> 3    NA         <NA> gsea
#> 4    NA         <NA> gsea
